title: hebeclinium guapulense

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Hebeclinium guapulense are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids and glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. Additionally, the plant's bioactive constituents may also contribute to its potential health benefits, including its use in treating fever and skin conditions, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
